scope: Local browser + actual client/Google handlers + memory store; Google/provider responses intercepted, zero live calls or emails.

checks.name: Starting Calendar records only a fresh state, slug, expiry and non-secret owner-session binding before the Google redirect
A valid same-session Google consent return connects automatically through the real authenticated handler once, with PKCE and encrypted credentials
Consent denial is completed automatically without token exchange or a false connected success message
A missing browser receipt never submits the Google callback
A different valid owner session cannot automatically process the original sign-in callback
different_slug: callback cannot auto-submit or exchange a code
different_state: callback cannot auto-submit or exchange a code
expired_receipt: callback cannot auto-submit or exchange a code
duplicate_state: callback cannot auto-submit or exchange a code
code_and_denial: callback cannot auto-submit or exchange a code
Legacy browser receipts retain an explicit completion action, protected by the same real server checks
An authenticated event for another workspace is not enough to automatically complete this return
Revoking the owner session before callback completion fails closed without token exchange
server_expiry: authoritative state checks override an otherwise matching browser receipt
newer_grant: authoritative state checks override an otherwise matching browser receipt
A lost browser completion response refreshes status and never automatically replays a one-use grant
Sign out during an in-flight continuation clears private UI and ignores the late response
